segments.name: Builder operations
segments.description: Builds and sells single family homes, townhomes, condos, luxury and patio homes to homebuyers in Texas, Georgia and Florida markets.
segments.evidence: Selling, general and administrative expenses as a percentage of revenue for builder operations was 11.0% compared to 10.9% in the prior year period.

revenueModel.text: Homebuyers pay the company for homes it builds and sells, and buyers of land parcels pay for lots and tracts of land sold.
revenueModel.evidence: We currently generate income from home sales in Texas, Georgia, and Florida.
